name: 纸松
description: Kami 纸系·松绿。宋体衬线+极浅暖白底+松绿 #3F7A5C 点缀，墨绿正文+渐变下划高亮、❧ 装饰分隔。清润自然，适合思考随笔、方法拆解、慢读长文

styles.container: background-color: #F7FAF6; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.h1: font-size: 27px; font-weight: 700; color: #3F7A5C; text-align: center; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 1px; border-bottom: 2px solid #3F7A5C; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #28332A; line-height: 1.5; border-left: 4px solid #3F7A5C; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #3F7A5C; line-height: 1.5; border-bottom: 1px solid #5C9678; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #28332A; border-left: 2px solid #e6e3da; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.5; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #28332A; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.h6: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #8a857c; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #28332A; line-height: 1.85; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-align: justify; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #3F7A5C; background: #EEF5EF; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; font-size: 15px; color: #8a857c; line-height: 1.78; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #28332A; line-height: 1.78; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif; letter-spacing: 0.2px;
styles.em: font-style: normal; color: #3F7A5C; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 4px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); background: transparent; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 34px; border: none; text-align: center; color: #3F7A5C; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 10px; content: ❧ ❧ ❧;
styles.code: background: #E9F1E9; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 14px; color: #3F7A5C; font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, Menlo, monospace;
styles.pre: background: #E9F1E9; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #e6e3da; color: #28332A; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 3px; background: #3F7A5C;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #28332A; font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, Menlo, monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 15px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.th: background: #EEF5EF; border-bottom: 2px solid #3F7A5C; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #28332A; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.td: border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e3da; color: #28332A; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: #DDEBDF; color: #3F7A5C; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #28332A; line-height: 1.85; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif; display: flex; margin-bottom: 9px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes h2: font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; color: #8a857c; margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #8a857c; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
styles.blockquote strong: font-weight: 700; color: #3F7A5C; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Songti SC','Source Han Serif SC','Noto Serif CJK SC','STSong',Georgia,serif;
